strongest_angle: Break down the California appeals court ruling allowing the Michael Crichton estate lawsuit over 'The Pitt' and 'ER' similarities to proceed to trial against Warner Bros Television.

key_facts.fact: A three-judge panel from California's 2nd District Court of Appeal ruled unanimously on Wednesday to deny an appeal from Warner Bros. Television regarding the lawsuit brought by Sherri Crichton.
Sherri Crichton controls the estate of her late husband Michael Crichton, who died in 2008 and co-created the long-running medical drama ER.
The HBO Max medical drama series The Pitt stars Noah Wyle, who also starred in the NBC hit series ER decades earlier.
